description: Source code for a Runtime class managing execution contexts, console message handling, and debugging utilities in a Firefox environment, with integration for worker environments and external services.

classes.name: Runtime
classes.description: Manages execution contexts, console message listening, and debugging in a Firefox environment, supporting worker and main thread contexts.

classes.name: ExecutionContext
classes.description: Represents an execution context within the Runtime, providing methods for evaluating scripts and functions, managing remote objects, and handling bindings.

methods.name: executionContexts
methods.description: Returns an array of current execution contexts.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates an expression in a specified execution context.

methods.name: callFunction
methods.description: Calls a function in a specified execution context with arguments.

methods.name: getObjectProperties
methods.description: Retrieves properties of an object in a given execution context.

methods.name: disposeObject
methods.description: Disposes of a remote object by its ID.

methods.name: createExecutionContext
methods.description: Creates and registers a new execution context.

methods.name: findExecutionContext
methods.description: Finds an execution context by its ID.

methods.name: destroyExecutionContext
methods.description: Removes and cleans up an execution context.

methods.name: evaluateScript
methods.description: Evaluates a script string within the context.

methods.name: evaluateFunction
methods.description: Evaluates a function with arguments within the context.

methods.name: addBinding
methods.description: Adds a binding (function) to the execution context.

methods.name: unsafeObject
methods.description: Returns an unsafe reference to a remote object.

methods.name: rawValueToRemoteObject
methods.description: Converts a raw value to a remote object.

methods.name: ensureSerializedToValue
methods.description: Serializes a protocol object to a value.

methods.name: _awaitPromise
methods.description: Awaits a promise object within the debuggee environment.
